title: Internals component diagram
description: The internals of the C# library: strict JSON reading and schema interpretation for structural validation, and the helpers the everyday operations share.

components.name: Structural validation internals
components.responsibility: Reads JSON strictly (StrictJson) and checks it against the embedded UTV schema (SchemaInterpreter).

components.name: Everyday internals
components.responsibility: Day arithmetic, exact rationals, UTV JSON reading and writing, and semantic failures turned into results.

components.name: UTV 1.0 structural schema
components.responsibility: schema/utv-1.0.schema.json, embedded into the assembly as resource Utv.utv-1.0.schema.json at build time.

components.name: UtvValidator
components.responsibility: The public entrypoint of structural validation, in the library's source root.

components.name: .NET base class library
components.responsibility: System.Text.Json (JsonDocument underneath StrictJson), System.Text.RegularExpressions (schema patterns) and System.Numerics (BigInteger).

relationships.description: The everyday helpers are a sub-namespace, Utv.Internal.Everyday.
SchemaInterpreter reads the embedded copy of the schema once, on first use.
ValidateStructural parses with StrictJson and checks with SchemaInterpreter.
Values.RequireStructural validates every operation argument first.
JsonDocument does the tokenizing; Regex with NonBacktracking runs schema patterns.
